review_method: Independent visual examination of the r55 original full recorded video across its complete 30 seconds, including all 901 decoded frames and representative motion views. Independently inspected its own 500 Hz record, 150000 5 kHz physics rows, all force/kinematic phases and actual original E30 pass.
visual_observation: Working diagonal steps advance from rigid ground through the material, with the body supported. The robot reaches the far end, turns in place and enters the material again during return. No collapse or dragging appears in the reviewed movement.

own_full_video.scope: Full recorded robot trajectory, visual-only strip overlay; no new integration or exaggerated deformation

own_material_counts.stage_initialization: This stage starts at original t=0 with its own virgin terrain. Other stages are separate histories.

material_traversal.measurement: First outbound base-projection passage from the west to east strip boundary without a side exit, with actual material-loaded feet during that passage. Uses original strip geometry and500Hz recorded states; no extra physical termination threshold or route change.

assessment: Normal sustained movement and exact-case original E30 qualification. The endpoint hold correction first receives a task-level test in this same r55 A E60.
